title: Three-bedroom property in North London
summary: A three-bedroom property for sale in North London, presented with supplied existing views and clearly labelled proposed interior concepts.

children.text: A three-bedroom property in North London, offered for sale through Haus of Estate. This draft brings together the supplied property imagery and a separate interior design proposal.

The proposed interiors explore ideas for the living and dining space, kitchen and bathroom areas. AI-assisted visuals illustrate possible furnishing, lighting and finishes; they do not show completed renovation works or confirm what is included in the sale.

Images labelled BEFORE show the existing views supplied with the proposal. Images labelled AFTER show proposed design concepts. Current condition, measurements and any proposed works must be verified separately.

verification.notes: Private draft prepared 6 October 2026. Haus Marketing email 2 October 2026, message 1a0fc0570afd32f4, confirms North London (subject), three bedrooms and sale intent. Forwarded 30 September proposal, message 1a0f2c329e8d0f2b, identifies AI-assisted initial concepts; AFTER is proposed appearance, not completed works. Five source boards visually inspected and SHA256-verified. Current-condition accuracy and image/marketing approval remain unverified. Address/postcode, asking price, property type, measured area, tenure/lease costs, council tax, EPC or exemption/commissioning, occupancy/current availability, material property information and floor plan are missing. No renovation-required/completed claim, measured plan, map pin or invented commercial fields. Reconcile this temporary title/slug to the verified property identity before publication.
